svg.text: LLA-3 — Firestore data model & RAG vector-search path
Three collections. Sessions denormalise the whole workspace into one document so a turn is one read and one write.
No join to sessions — read by the RAG service only, at query time.
One document per consultation: a turn is exactly one get() + one update().
Written once at onboarding; read on every session start.
Index — must exist before the first query, and takes minutes to build. Create it on day one:
gcloud alpha firestore indexes composite create --collection-group=knowledge_base --query-scope=COLLECTION \
client access denied — server (Admin SDK) only
